summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] 10‑second humorous short video set within <Subject 2> ancient temple courtyard. <Subject 1> tactical‑harness husky performs sarcastic lazy monologue with rich facial expressions and physical comedy actions across three tightly framed shots. All compositions avoid wide panoramas and heavy background blur, using only medium‑close shots, close‑ups and extreme close‑ups to emphasize the husky’s comedic performance. <Audio 1> supplies Chinese comedic voice reference, temple ambient sound runs throughout.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - retains black‑and‑white fur, ice‑blue eyes, dark‑gray tactical harness, three‑view asset features; added customized silly expression & movement animations for comedy performance.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): partially_preserved - retains temple buildings, giant ancient tree, sunset golden light, stone lantern props; animated drifting mist converts static reference picture into living scene; framing is reframed into closer camera distances instead of wide establishing composition.

detailed_description:
Semi‑realistic 3D‑CG rendering, warm golden sunset rim light, soft shadows, slapstick relaxed comedic atmosphere, total runtime 10.000 seconds.
[Shot 1] Medium‑close shot, eye‑level 50mm standard lens, deep enough focus to keep the temple courtyard and giant ancient tree visible behind the subject, no heavy background blur. <Subject 1> stands on left foreground of courtyard before the giant ancient tree of <Subject 2>, occupying most of the frame. Posture: body stands slightly stiffened by the tactical harness, neck twists, head sharply tilted 35 degrees to one side. Facial expression: one ear stands upright, the other ear flops down loosely; ice‑blue eyes half‑squinted, eyebrows twisted, face full of confused disbelief. Camera ultra‑slow gentle push‑in. <Subject 1> (S1) speaks with confused baffled mood, lazy cheeky tone referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 还给我整上装备了？派我来看庙？</d>. After speaking, dog sniffs the tactical harness strap with nose, gives a slight body shrug. Soft mist drifts behind, stone lantern glows warm yellow. Timecode: 00:00.000‑00:03.400.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.400 hard‑cut to extreme close‑up, eye‑level 50mm lens, focus remains sharp on <Subject 1>’s face while the temple courtyard stays clearly recognizable in the background, no heavy bokeh. Frame tightly frames <Subject 1>’s whole face and upper harness strap. Action & expression: both ears droop completely, eyeballs roll hard toward upper‑side corner, obvious sarcastic eye‑roll, corners of mouth twist downward, looks thoroughly uninterested. Jaw moves synchronously with dialogue. <Subject 1> (S1) delivers line in deadpan, dismissive sarcastic mood, <d>[Chinese] 拉倒吧，站岗哪有躺平舒服。</d>. Right after finishing line: nose blows out exaggerated heavy huff, cheeks puff slightly, head gives a tiny weary shake. Comedic huff sound‑effect syncs to this action. Timecode: 00:03.400‑00:06.600.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.600 quick hard‑cut, medium‑close shot with slightly low camera angle, 50mm lens, temple courtyard background remains fully visible and relatively sharp, no high‑angle aerial wide establishing shot. <Subject 1> is centered in the lower half of the frame, close enough to show body language and facial expressions. Sequence of physical actions: half spin on spot to show harness‑wearing side‑back view from reference asset; hind legs buckle suddenly, front paws slip slightly; whole body flops sideways onto cool stone pavement, limbs splayed out messily, belly partially exposed. Expression: ears hang floppy, head lolls sideways on ground, eyes half closed in defeated relaxation. No dialogue. Small looping idle animation: subtle tail wag, occasional tiny ear twitch. Camera locked static, mist drifts slowly behind the temple buildings until end frame 00:10.000.
overall_soundscape:
Soft continuous temple courtyard ambient noise for full 10 seconds; distant wind rustling big‑tree leaves, faint stone lantern ambient hum; synchronized exaggerated comedic huff sound‑effect on Shot2 punch moment.
non_diegetic_music:
Light playful comedic instrumental with plucked strings; small light percussion taps hit exactly on punch‑line moments; volume stays lower than character voice; fades completely out at 10‑second ending frame.
